About us: RRD GO Creative, with more than three decades of expertise in business communications, marketing solutions, and digital productivity solutions, we successfully help reimagine customer experiences for companies. Our three pillars of Global Brand Solutions, Smart Work Solutions, and Technology & Innovation Services transform the way businesses work for customers, building strong brand loyalty.

Our 8,000 experts in 42 locations work across various industries to co-create a future-ready business landscape. We adopt a consultative approach to digitizing every aspect of the Customer Journey so you can effectively translate a strategic vision of expansion and efficiency into a superior Customer Experience. We help you effectively address customer needs so you can make Customer Experience your competitive differentiator.




RRD GO CREATIVE currently seeking Analyst-Data Visualization for Creative Communications team to join in Chennai

Interested candidates please apply using the below link:

https://forms.gle/fsu1b3v9SsnthGsu9




Core Responsibilities:

Collect, clean, and validate data from multiple internal and external sources.
Present the data and discuss the different probable representations that can be showcased to the client.
Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and KPIs
Collaborate with stakeholders to define business questions and analytical needs
Translate data insights into clear, actionable recommendations
Work with large datasets
Monitor data quality and suggest improvements in data collection or structure
Document analysis processes and create reproducible workflows
Create documentation for all new process that are added to the workflow
Training and transition of new reports



Hard Skills:



Proficiency in SQL for querying relational databases
Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, formulas and the ability to write and edit macros
Experience with BI and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI etc.)
Familiarity with basic statistical concepts
Basic scripting skills in Python or R



Soft Skills:



Analytical and problem-solving ability with attention to detail
Strong written and verbal communication
Ability to explain technical findings to non-technical audiences & clients
Time management and ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously



Education:

Bachelor's degree in mathematics, Data science, Computer Science, Statistics or relevant experience



Shift:

Rotational shift including night shift

Role & responsibilities

Exp: 3 to 8 years
Shift Timings: Normal Shift
Hybrid/Remote: Hybrid


Mandate Skills:

Open Text Operations Bridge Manager (OBM)

Open Text UCMDB

OpenText Aviator (Generative AI for IT Operations)




Description:

Professional with 3-8 years of experience in OpenText/Micro Focus IT Operations Management and Service Management platforms, capable of supporting enterprise monitoring, CMDB, ITSM, and AIOps ecosystems, with exposure to cloud, automation, and AI-enabled operations.




Mandatory Primary Skills:

Candidates should have proven hands-on experience in deployment, configuration, and support of OpenText ITOM/ITSM platforms including Incident troubleshooting and root cause analysis, Monitoring administration, event management, CMDB administration, and service modeling. Integration between monitoring, CMDB, and ITSM tools. ITIL-based service management processes and Production support and operational environments. Should be adept in the following Tools & Platforms:




1. Open Text Operations Bridge Manager (OBM) - Event Management and Correlation, AIOps and Intelligent Event Processing. Event Forwarding and Integrations, Topology-Based Event Correlation (TBEC), Dashboard and Reporting Configuration, Operations Agent and Monitoring Administration.




2. Open Text UCMDB - Configuration Management Database (CMDB) Administration, Service Modeling and Business Service Views, CI Lifecycle Management, Discovery and Dependency Mapping, Data Synchronization and Reconciliation, UCMDB Integrations with Monitoring and ITSM Platforms.




3. Open Text Network Node Manager I (NNMi) - Network Monitoring Administration, Network Topology Discovery, Fault Management and Root Cause Analysis, SNMP Configuration and Device Monitoring, Network Event Correlation, Performance Monitoring and Reporting.




4. OpenText SMAX (Service Management Automation X) - Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Asset Management, Service Catalog and Workflow Configuration, Knowledge Management, ITSM Process Design and Implementation, Service Portal Administration, Integration with UCMDB and Monitoring Platforms.




5. OpenText Aviator (Generative AI for IT Operations) - AI-Assisted Service Desk Operations

Ticket Summarization and Knowledge Retrieval, AI-enabled Incident Resolution Support, Prompt Configuration and AI Model Administration, Integration of Aviator with SMAX and IT Operations workflows.




Preferred Skills:

1. Experience in Open Text ITOM Ecosystem - Operations Agent (OA), SiteScope, Business Process Monitor (BPM), Real User Monitor (RUM), AppPulse / Digital Experience Monitoring, Operations Connector (OpsCx) and Intelligent Service Management.

2. Automation & Scripting PowerShell, Shell Scripting (Bash), Python, REST APIs, JSON/XML.

Any relevant certifications in OpenText Operations, UCMDB, SMAX, ITOM/Observability would be an added advantage.
